# aether_registry_robot_account (Resource)

A robot account (non-expiring `docker login` credential) of the organization's registry. It does not require `aether_registry` to exist. The API has no update route, so any change replaces the robot account (a new secret is issued). `create_before_destroy` is unsupported: the name is held until the old robot account is deleted, so the replacement is refused with 409. Destroying `aether_registry` removes every robot account out of band (they are recreated on the next apply); order destroys with `depends_on` on the registry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Robot account name, unique within the organization. Changing it replaces the robot account.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Any of `push`, `pull`, `delete`. `push` implies `pull` in the registry; the stored value is what you sent. Changing it replaces the robot account.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `harbor_id` (Number) The robot's id in the registry backend.
- `harbor_username` (String) The `docker login` username (`robot$aether-<organization slug>+<name>`).
- `id` (String) Robot account UUID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The robot's secret (the `docker login` password). Returned by the API only on creation, so it is null after an import.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the robot account was last written (RFC 3339).
